evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensor: drop from 11.87 mg/L at 45.8 h to 7.81 at 46.0 h, declining to 6.55 mg/L by 51.8 h (rows 229–259)
Receiving DO is ~2.5–3 mg/L below source batches 1–3 at the same age (source ~9.2–10.5 mg/L at 47–52 h)
Local linear fit of receiving DO, 46–52 h: slope ≈ -1.98 mg/L per 10 h; extrapolated to cross 2 mg/L near ~75 h
Forward model KEEP: nominal post-decision min DO 2.14 mg/L; sensitivity min 1.63 mg/L (infeasible member)
Forward model combined: nominal min DO 2.66 mg/L; sensitivity min 1.85 mg/L (infeasible member)
Forward model strong_feed_reduction: nominal min DO 4.18 mg/L; all 5 sensitivity members feasible, range 2.26–6.32 mg/L; product mass 622 kg nominal
Receiving product assay at 47.8 h: 3.20 g/L, on trend with source batches at same age
args.rationale: At decision time 52 h, the receiving DO2 has departed sharply from source behavior: it dropped step-like from ~11.9 to ~7.8 mg/L at 46 h and is declining ~2 mg/L per 10 h (6.55 mg/L at 51.8 h), whereas source batches held ~9–10.5 mg/L at the same age. Linear extrapolation reaches the 2 mg/L hard limit near ~75 h, so continued KEEP is at material risk of violating the constraint. The nominal source-calibrated forward model confirms KEEP is marginal (post-decision min DO 2.14 mg/L, only 0.14 mg/L margin, with an infeasible sensitivity member at 1.63 mg/L). strong_feed_reduction (0.6x feed, 1.15x air) is the only plan that is centrally feasible with a large margin (nominal min DO 4.18 mg/L) AND feasible across all 5 sensitivity members (2.26–6.32 mg/L), while retaining the highest predicted product mass (622 kg nominal vs 269 kg for KEEP). increase_air/combined/reduce_feed each centrally meet the limit but carry infeasible sensitivity members (1.67, 1.85, 1.65 mg/L). Per the decision priorities, a centrally marginal plan with an infeasible sensitivity member is not justified, and among robustly feasible plans strong_feed_reduction retains the most product mass. No stop is warranted because a supported feasible plan exists.
args.uncertainty: The forward model is source-calibrated and imperfect (estimated transfer multiplier 0.61), so its DO and product-mass predictions are indicative, not truth. The sharp DO drop at 46 h suggests a receiving-specific regime change (higher oxygen demand or reduced transfer) that the model may not fully capture; the local trend (-2 mg/L/10 h) is fit on only ~6 h of noisy sensor data. Even under the model's full sensitivity set, however, strong_feed_reduction keeps DO >= 2.26 mg/L, whereas every other operating plan has at least one infeasible member. Product mass under strong_feed_reduction ranges 266–627 kg across sensitivity members, so mass gain is uncertain but the constraint margin is robust. Residual risk: an unmodeled further deterioration in oxygen transfer could erode the margin; continued DO monitoring post-decision is advisable.
